findings.issue: The inverse branch of `evenOdd_map_realCliffordFourZeroVolumeConj` unfolds the inverse conjugation through a seven-lemma `simp only` chain (`MulSemiringAction.toAlgEquiv_symm_apply`, `ConjAct.ofConjAct_inv`, ...). It will break on Mathlib renames, while the forward direction uses `realCliffordFourZeroVolumeConj_apply`.

summary: Proofs are robust and free of undocumented defeq, but the filtration counterexample inlines a reusable general fact (odd elements of filtration Q 1 are vectors), and the inverse-conjugation branch relies on an ad-hoc chain of ConjAct lemma names instead of a symm_apply lemma.
